manifest.root_cause: The harness shipped with no execution guidance at all (empty CLAUDE.md, empty hooks/settings), so the agent had no instruction to convert reasoning into tool calls. Under a weak/unrecognized backend model it emitted thinking-token telemetry turn after turn, never wrote the required artifact or ran tests, and the fixed 40-turn cap terminated the run before any file existed. Secondary: with no permission allowlist, interactive tool use could stall in a headless run.
manifest.targeted_fix: Added an always-loaded CLAUDE.md execution protocol that mandates a tool call in the first response, forbids consecutive non-tool turns, requires a runnable skeleton of every required output path within the first few calls, time-boxes environment setup, and reserves final turns for artifact verification. Added the algorithm-implementation skill encoding a reusable skeleton-first, validate-inputs, modular, seeded-statistical-test workflow with exact TEST_NAME: PASS/FAIL output. Added a permissions allowlist so Bash/Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep never block the run.
